verdict.rationale: Omarchy has a built-in Install section in the Omarchy Menu for curated software: editors such as VSCode, Cursor and Zed, terminals, development environments, and a Windows VM. Popular apps like Zoom, Spotify and Steam come preinstalled, and one hands-on user says installing software is easy and fast. However, the menu is keyboard-driven and limited to curated categories, not a browsable one-click app store for desktop apps in general. Missing for 10: a documented graphical app-store experience, evidence of one-click installs for arbitrary popular desktop apps beyond the curated dev/editor/terminal lists, and independent corroboration of the install menu specifically.
